company.description: Company name derived from the domain you passed.

ats.description: Board provider: greenhouse, ashby, lever, workable, smartrecruiters or recruitee.

department.description: Department or team, when the board exposes it.

remote.description: true when the company marks the job as remote.

employmentType.description: Full-time, contract, intern and so on.

salaryMin.description: Lower bound of the published salary.

salaryMax.description: Upper bound of the published salary.

postedAt.description: Publication or last update time as the ATS reports it.

url.description: Direct link to the job posting.

status.description: FOUND for a delivered job. NO_JOBS means the board answered and nothing matched, or it has no open jobs. FAILED means the company could not be resolved. DUPLICATE_BOARD means this input resolves to the same board as an earlier row and carried no job that was not already delivered. NOT_CHECKED_CAP, NOT_CHECKED_MAX_COMPANIES, NOT_CHECKED_BILLING and NOT_CHECKED mean the run never reached that company - those are never NO_JOBS.

reason.description: Plain-language reason for any row that is not FOUND: why the company failed, why nothing matched, why it was not checked, or why it is a duplicate.

jobsOnBoard.description: How many open jobs the board itself held when it was read.

boardSlug.description: Slug of the board inside its ATS, as detected.

error.description: Machine-readable failure code (NO_ATS_FOUND, UNSUPPORTED_ATS) when the company could not be resolved.

jobDescription.description: Full job description as plain text, only with includeDescription.

fromCache.description: true when this row came from the run cache instead of a live fetch - same data, no extra request to the board.
